newsitem.title: UK: Britain hopes Chechnya peace unhurt by Lebed move.
newsitem.headline: Britain hopes Chechnya peace unhurt by Lebed move.

text.p: Britain said on Thursday it hoped the sacking of Russian security chief Alexander Lebed would not hurt the peace process in breakaway Chechnya.
"We hope this development will not adversely affect the Chechnya peace process," a spokesman for the Foreign Office said.
The Foreign Office declined further comment on Lebed's sacking by Russian President Boris Yeltsin.
"We are aware of ... Lebed's dismissal. It's not for us to comment on internal Russian politics," the spokesman said.
Lebed signed a peace deal with Chechen rebels and said after his dismissal that events in Chechnya would now get worse.
